sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Western Dani language' and (id) 'Bahasa Dani Barat', accessed 2026-09-17

sources.citation: Supardi. 2016. Temporalitas pada verba dalam bahasa Dani Barat. LITERA 15(1): 12-22. doi:10.21831/ltr.v15i1.9752
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Verb tense/temporality only; no phonology or stress. Notes (p. 15) that Purba dkk. studied the phonology in 1993 and morphology in 1994; bibliography (p. 22) gives Purba dkk. 1994 Morfologi Bahasa Dani Barat and Purba dkk. 2000 'Variasi struktur bahasa daerah di Irian Jaya', Jurnal MLI 18(1): 77-98.

sources.citation: Bromley, H. Myron. 1961. The Phonology of Lower Grand Valley Dani: A Comparative Structural Study of Skewed Phonemic Patterns (Verhandelingen KITLV 34). 's-Gravenhage: Martinus Nijhoff. doi:10.26530/oapen_613378
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 2.2 'The pattern of Western Dani' (pp. 8-10, data from Gordon Larson for Ilaga/Tinak, Sheila Draper and Bromley for North Baliem, Ross Bartel for Hablifoeri) gives only the consonant/vowel pattern and distribution of WD; it says nothing about WD stress. The stress statement in sec. 3.132 (p. 49: 'The phonological word consists of a syllable or group of syllables with only one primary word stress. Since this stress occurs on final syllables of words in most cases..') describes Lower Grand Valley Dani (a different language), not west2594.

Harvard holds a print copy (Widener Library (offsite storage) PL6621.W48 B37 2008) — a library scan of the phonology chapter would settle this.
